subjects: versioned module cards on a registry shelf
a sanitized copy separated from a locked secrets drawer
composition: keep the registry structure readable at the size it is actually shown
support the written story rather than replacing it
text_policy: narrative raster assets carry one short title plus one short subtitle; icons, SVGs, and helper graphics remain text-free
reject_when: an asset implies secret values are stored in git
a title or subtitle is unreadable at its placed size
an image pretends narrative rasters exist while the manifest ships none
the visual repeats a claim the README has not tied to evidence
